text:
alex: Quick heads-up: Marketing wants a short stunt in early May — ~72h spike. They estimate ~2-3x current peak. Can we do a cost-effective mix of preemptible/spot + reserved capacity? Any quota or vendor lead-time issues? cc @maria @kevin

maria: Need rough numbers + region + model size. That changes whether we target A100 vs A10s.

alex: Rough numbers: baseline ~200 tokens/s. Target ~600 tokens/s for 72 hours. Model is crimson-8b (fp16). Prefer us-west1 primary, failover to us-east1.

kevin: Short answer: probably yes. We currently have ~120 reserved A100 slots in us-west1 — that's ~250 tokens/s for crimson-8b. So we need ~350 tokens/s extra capacity. Preemptible/spot should cover it but quotas matter.

kevin: ```
# quick quota check (example)
gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --format="value(quotas)"
# parsed output (abbrev):
# gpuQuota: 240
# gpuUsed: 120
```

capacity-bot: US-west1 spot GPU availability: A100: medium, A10: high. Estimated time to scale spot pool: 6-12h (vendor pool resize).

sara: @vendors-inc-bot can you confirm lead times for a short guaranteed burst? If vendors can do a 72h guaranteed non-preemptible warm pool, that changes cost math.

vendors-inc-bot: We can offer a guaranteed burst for A100s with 7-day notice at an uplifted rate. Shorter notice (<7d) is possible but not guaranteed and may incur higher fees.

maria: Ok — assume 7d notice for guaranteed A100 burst. Plan B: hybrid approach: keep reserved baseline + spin preemptible A10s for bulk of burst, with autoscaling + fallback to east reserved pool. Draft plan below.

maria: ```
autoscaler:
  min_replicas: 10
  max_replicas: 300
  nodePools:
    reserved_us_west1: 120 # A100
    preemptible_us_west1: 0-350 # A10s, scale as needed
    fallback_us_east1: reserved_pool
scalingPolicy: prefer_local_then_fallback
```

sam: I opened a quota request: https://cloud-console.example/requests/REQ-1234 — labeled "marketing spike Q2". Support says initial review ~48h.

kevin: Two action items from infra side: 1) procurement to confirm vendor 7d burst + pricing 2) infra to run autoscale/eviction dry-run on staging (simulate preemptible churn).

alex: I'll file the procurement ticket and loop in finance. Proceed with autoscale test in parallel. If vendor confirms 7d option we can lock a small guaranteed pool. :thumbsup:

maria: Scheduling dry-run this Fri 09:00 PT to simulate 3x load + eviction events. @kevin can you own the test and post runbook?

kevin: Yep — I'll own it. Will post runbook + expected metrics (latency, token/s, failover time) after test. TL;DR: feasible if procurement signs off on burst fee.

alex: Thanks all — please update the ticket with any vendor cost numbers and results from the Friday test.

(reacts: :eyes: from maria, :rocket: from alex)
